title: Dirty regions and composite caches
workloads: small local edit in many layers
opacity/reorder/groups when supported
zoomed-out composition, halo filters and resource invalidation
correctness_gates: ordered compositing and full oracle output
downsample/composite order respected
late cache result cannot publish obsolete preview
invalid_comparisons: approximated lower-quality output as exact
cache key missing policy/resource identity
ignoring maintenance cost
decision_rule: Qualify cache policies only where correctness and total workload costs improve.

title: CPU worker-pool execution
variants: Rayon pool under the same PaintCraft scheduler/budget
workloads: 1, 8 and many independent output tiles; small and expensive kernels
thread caps 1/2/4 and available admitted cores
sustained interactive samples while effects, history compression and a threaded codec run
correctness_gates: identical ordered output and no lost samples
same total process concurrency budget including codec threads
cancellation/drain/shutdown and nested joins are live
supplementary_metrics: CPU time, queue length and cancellation age
invalid_comparisons: Rayon full-core run versus deliberately starved baseline
only idle bulk throughput, no interactive interference
claiming work stealing implements task priorities
decision_rule: Use Rayon where it improves qualified tile workloads; retain direct execution for tiny jobs and a bounded scheduler above all pools.

title: Recorded history payload strategy
workloads: tiny rectangle and diagonal sparse stroke
full-layer filter and structural edits
long undo/redo chains and held snapshots
correctness_gates: bit-exact undo/redo including hidden RGB
no effect replay
bounded patch depth and recoverable references
invalid_comparisons: patch payload only, ignoring pinned base tiles
timing redo by recomputing effect
unbounded patch chains
decision_rule: Adopt the lowest total cost subject to exact restore and bounded ownership, with measured thresholds.

title: History/block compression
variants: Zstd levels chosen for same mode
workloads: uniform, natural and high-entropy RGBA tiles
u8 masks and implemented higher-depth data
hot undo and cold spill; many small versus batched blocks
correctness_gates: exact decode and checksums
budgeted scratch and worker count
corruption/failure leaves authority intact
invalid_comparisons: free compression worker budget
counting compressed copy while raw stays pinned
network samples not present in actual corpus
decision_rule: Choose hot/cold policies by ratio and latency; raw is valid for incompressible content.

title: CPU/GPU operation crossover
workloads: small adjustments and large blur/resample
vary dirty region not only canvas size
multiple accepted strokes with bounded readback/commit queue
correctness_gates: same policy/tolerance and final pixels
readback completed before claimed commit
cancellation/device loss handled
invalid_comparisons: timing CPU complete versus GPU submitted
hiding transfer costs
committing GPU-only pixels
decision_rule: Derive workload-specific thresholds; resident and cold paths are different policies with identical semantics.
remaining_scope: Streamed/resident source reuse and completed native texture readiness are locally compared. CPU/GPU crossover thresholds, effect kernels, energy and native OS input/display traces remain unqualified.

title: Exact integer dense-span SIMD
workloads: dense opaque destination, aligned and odd widths
short opaque spans
mixed destination alpha
sparse and uniform controls
correctness_gates: independent integer oracle and full document parity
opacity, hidden RGB, unaligned slices and tails
cancellation and region boundaries
invalid_comparisons: float approximation as exact integer output
deoptimized scalar baseline
target-cpu=native as generic target evidence

title: Codec implementation routes
variants: selected ag-psd 0.3.0 finite-f32 ASE baseline; no replacement comparison yet
workloads: empty and mixed-model palette resources
grouped 256/4096 swatches with Unicode names
complete CLI inspection and durable fresh-copy export
correctness_gates: exact groups names models types and channel bits in an independent parser
bounded preflight and supported asset operations only
source immutability and complete output teardown
supplementary_metrics: Hyperfine process RSS CPU and file sizes
invalid_comparisons: different precision metadata quality or operations as equivalent work
process RSS as an adapter heap budget
palette throughput as interactive brush latency
single-backend baseline as a codec optimization winner
